name: TH Tuition Billing Register
query:
select
	fees.name as fees,
	fees.student as student,
	fees.program_enrollment as program_enrollment,
	fees.academic_year as academic_year,
	fees.posting_date as posting_date,
	fees.due_date as due_date,
	fees.grand_total as grand_total,
	fees.outstanding_amount as outstanding_amount,
	fees.docstatus as docstatus
from tabFees fees
order by fees.posting_date, fees.name
